page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t5-c1m4.large is a burstable virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.t5 family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The configuration provides 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled, resulting in 2 threads per core. It features 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 4.0 GB per core ratio. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates under a KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark data indicates that this instance is positioned at the lower tier of performance. In stress-ng testing, the single-core CPU performance scored 1057.79, while multi-core performance reached 2090.03. Geekbench results show a single-core score of 870.0 and a multi-core score of 1493.0. Memory bandwidth is also constrained, with read-only large block transfers measured at 16.3 GB/sec and write large block transfers at 14.44 GB/sec. Static web serving throughput is recorded at 1.48 GB/sec, and Redis SET operations achieve 2.54 million operations per second.

Due to its burstable CPU allocation and baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps, this instance is designed for low-cost, low-utilization workloads. It offers a cost-effective entry point for tasks that experience occasional spikes in demand but remain idle most of the time. Appropriate workloads include lightweight web serving, development and testing environments, code repositories, and basic microservices that do not require sustained high CPU performance or high-speed local storage.
